understanding: Fetal femur ultrasound tutorial matching probe diagrams to fetal anatomy images across cephalic, breech and transverse presentations.

tasks.question: In this fetal cross-section, how does the marked stomach compare with the marked spine in brightness and depth?
tasks.reference_answer: The stomach is a darker pocket above the brighter spine echoes.
tasks.visual_support: The stomach arrow points into a dark pocket near the upper part of the fetal profile and the spine arrow points to bright echoes below.
tasks.query_prefix_check: Both landmarks are marked in the current image.
